# Psalm 118 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Give thanks to the LORD because he is good — his faithful love lasts forever!

**2** Let all Israel say it: 'His faithful love lasts forever!'

**3** Let all the priests of Aaron's family say it: 'His faithful love lasts forever!'

**4** Let everyone who honors the LORD say it: 'His faithful love lasts forever!'

**5** In my desperation I cried out to the LORD, and the LORD answered by setting me free!

**6** The LORD is with me — I will not be afraid. What can any human being do to me?

**7** The LORD is with me as my helper; I will watch my enemies go down.

**8** It's better to take refuge in the LORD than to put your confidence in people.

**9** It's better to take refuge in the LORD than to put your confidence in powerful leaders.

**10** Every nation on earth surrounded me, but in the LORD's name I destroyed them.

**11** They closed in on me from every direction, but in the LORD's name I destroyed them.

**12** They swarmed me like bees, but they burned out like a fire in dry thorns — in the LORD's name I destroyed them.

**13** I was shoved hard and about to collapse, but the LORD caught me.

**14** The LORD is my strength and my song — he has become my salvation!

**15** Listen to the shouts of joy and victory in the camps of the righteous: 'The LORD's right hand has done powerful things!

**16** The LORD's right hand is lifted high! The LORD's right hand has done powerful things!'

**17** I will not die — I will live! And I will tell everyone what the LORD has done.

**18** The LORD punished me severely, but he did not let me die.

**19** Open the gates of righteousness for me! I will walk through them and thank the LORD!

**20** This is the LORD's gate — only the righteous can enter.

**21** I thank you for answering me; you have become my salvation!

**22** The stone the builders rejected has turned out to be the most important stone of all!

**23** The LORD has done this, and it is absolutely amazing to see!

**24** This is the day the LORD has made — let's celebrate and be happy today!

**25** LORD, save us, we beg you! LORD, give us success, we beg you!

**26** Blessed is the one who comes in the LORD's name! We bless you from the LORD's house!

**27** The LORD is God, and he has shone his light on us! Tie the festival sacrifice to the horns of the altar with ropes!

**28** You are my God, and I will thank you! You are my God, and I will praise you!

**29** Give thanks to the LORD because he is good — his faithful love lasts forever!

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **118:22-23**: The stone the builders threw away turned out to be the most important one in the whole building. Jesus quoted this about himself: rejected by the religious leaders, but chosen by God as the foundation of everything. It's the ultimate underdog story.

- **118:24-26**: These verses were sung by the crowd when Jesus entered Jerusalem on Palm Sunday. 'Hosanna!' ('Save us!') and 'Blessed is the one who comes in the LORD's name!' — they were quoting this psalm without fully realizing what they were saying.

— PNEUMA
